Prairie Dawn | Prairie Dawn is a fictional character, a rather mature seven-year-old Muppet girl on the children's television program "Sesame Street".  She is similar in appearance to a character from the Anything Muppets.  She is famous for writing school pageants (e.g., Sesame Street Little Theater) for her friends, mostly Bert and Ernie, Herry, Grover, and Cookie Monster. Prairie was originally puppeteered and voiced by Fran Brill who also performed the more recently introduced character Zoe.
